description_expanded: Overview5.0(5 reviews)DUNE ALLEN BEACH – Key Lime Cottage Charming Beach Retreat | Community Pool | Sleeps 4 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Key Lime Cottage, a serene and charming retreat nestled on the west end of 30A. Offering the perfect blend of style, comfort and proximity to all that 30A and the Emerald Coast has to offer, this delightful condo is the ultimate getaway for those seeking relaxation, adventure, and easy access to the breathtaking Gulf Coast. Whether you're here to unwind by the pool, explore the stunning beaches, or savor local cuisine, Key Lime Cottage provides a welcoming home away from home. This peaceful haven is located steps from the community pool and just a short ride from the Dune Allen Public Beach, Topsail Hill Preserve State Park. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax and soak up the Florida sun in the community pool, located just across from the condo. For beach lovers, Dune Allen Beach is closeby, offering access to pristine sands and emerald waters. Explore the 19-mile scenic bike trail along 30A or spend your days in the beauty of nearby nature reserves and state parks. HOME FEATURES 2 bedrooms | 2 bathroom | Sleeps 4 Queen bed in the primary suite and 2 twin beds in the guest bedroom Fully equipped kitchen with sleek appliances and granite countertops Washer/dryer for your convenience Elegant, newly furnished interiors for ultimate comfort Complimentary Wi-Fi Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Gulf Place, and Grand Blvd for dining and shopping Enjoy boutique shops, live music, and art galleries in Gulf Place Explore nearby nature trails and coastal dune lakes for outdoor adventures WHY STAY HERE? Perfect for small families or couples seeking a tranquil retreat Family-friendly with a relaxed, laid-back vibe Easy access to 30A’s best attractions, and local dining Community pool A peaceful setting that’s away from the crowds but close to everything Key Lime Cottage is your ideal base for a memorable getaway on 30A, blending comfort, nature, and adventure into one perfect vacation spot!Show less
